_comment: Hand-authored oracle list for `wp mvs cert contract`. Each oracle flips its gating option OFF then ON and dispatches the guarded REST route both times. It passes only when the OFF dispatch emits `off_code` AND the ON dispatch does not — proving the toggle actually enforces behaviour (no dead toggles). `kind` is 'option' (a standalone WP option, written as string '1'/'0') or 'feature' (a slug inside the aggregate `feature_store` option).
_uncovered_by_design: Most WPMediaVerse gates cannot use the flip-and-dispatch pattern and are covered by journey runbooks instead: (1) Privacy/visibility (mvs_default_privacy, mvs_allow_user_privacy, mvs_dm_access, mvs_show_online_status) is enforced inside the SQL/query layer and returns filtered result sets, not a distinct disabled error code — see audit/journeys/customer/02-media-upload-non-public.md and 05-dm-access-setting-persists.md. (2) Media-optimization toggles (mvs_optimize_originals, mvs_generate_webp, mvs_generate_avif) act during the upload pipeline, not on a GET route. (3) AI auto-* toggles (mvs_ai_auto_analyze, mvs_ai_auto_apply_tags, mvs_ai_auto_moderate) gate background processing — see audit/journeys/admin/09-ai-features-owner-control.md. (4) Pro gamification toggles are registration-gated (the route deregisters when off) and live in the Pro cert. These appear below in `toggles` and surface as tracked HOLES, not failures.
